title: Raga Madhuwanti
description: Subject: Music (Hindustani Classical)  Courses: Raag Ranjan

asr.full_text: The The The The The The The The The The The patient is in the sleep of the sleeping Friends, music is a full power that can control a person. It is consciousness. It is energy. The power of music, the source of music.. ..the pure power.. ..is appreciated by the modern age. Come, let's learn more about it. The melody is Madhuvani. It is also appreciated by modern times. Come, let us learn more about it. The tune is Madhuvanti. And we will guide on this tune.. ..by music expert Pandit Vijay. Greetings. Sir, I welcome you to this meeting. The tune we have chosen for today's discussion is Madhuvanti. What are the arohas and aro form of the music is We call it the ragang of a rag. It has important phrases. We call it pakad. I will sing it for you. Mother, please come to me Mother, please come to me I am a mother, I am a mother Mother, please come to me . You told us the form of a rag. The main notes of a rag and the basic notes.. ..that we refer to as Vadi Samvadi, what are they? The main note in this Madhuvanti rag is Pancham. They call it Pa. And Shadja. Vadi Samvadi, Pancham and Shadja. Apart fromabh. These three songs are important in this. Marwadi, Samadhi, Pancham and Shadja. First, Mr. Mukund, he sang the song of Mirat. Now you sang it in detail. It seems that the nature of this tune is very deep. What is the actual feeling of this? The feeling is expressed only when it is in words. In the form of a bandish. And according to me, this is Karun ras till Pancham. Okay. And from Pancham till Sharjah, there is Anand ras in Uttarang. Okay. So there is a mix of both. The Uttarang has the joy of bliss from the 5th. So both are mixed. If you sing till the 5th, you will experience the joy of Karuna. And from the 5th till the 6th, it has the joy of bliss. We have taken this feeling in the creation of this Meera. Karunyamayi Bhajan. Yes. He sings in that style. Yes. Now you have explained the explanation of the song. We would like to listen to the whole song in which.. ..the bandish is played. Yes. Absolutely. I will play a bandish in the middle of the japtal. Yes. Come, let us go to the village Oh beloved, my beloved, let's go to the palace Wow! Wonderful! Very good. Wow! Wow! One question that will remain in the minds of all people, and for me too, is that what should be called a bandish? I am saying this in this way that songs like in films, like the songs of Ghazals, Sugam or Lalit, whatever you call it, those songs, what are the different aspects of bandish? Suppose there is a phrase in the mind, a form of a word, that there should be something in the mind. If the creator feels that, then he will create a word in it. And this is how a bandish is made. Sometimes it happens that a bandish is not made by one person, but by two people? Yes, I will give you an example. My Guruji, Dr. Vasant Rao Deshpande and Kumar Ji, both have created this stai, and the antara by Kumar Ji. Were they made together? No, not together, separately First the Aasthaai is done The words and notation are done After that the Antara is done Later both are combined and the Bandish is done It is a Bandish like this I will tell you It is not in three taals It is written like this Please explain the meaning of it. This is the sthaa made by Dr. Vasant Raoji. And the Antara is I will sing it. This is the reason why this popular Ghazal, everyone knows Madan Mohan's Ghazal, written by Naxlal Puri. It is mostly made in Purvang. The Antara goes up but that's why Karunta is used. How to save the heart? I fulfilled my duties on him The pain of the How to tell the story of broken heart? How to keep the love in the essence? The Lali music, that that is Sugam music.. ..has been used a lot. You had told us that the former part of the music.. ..is Karunyamayi and the latter part is Anandamayi. Our musicians have used both of them so well.. ..in Sugam music. So let's come back to our Shastriya era. This thought is also a part of our history. Every time a performance is performed... ...this thought comes first. You get your form of laya in Shastrian music. It is similar to a lot of other forms of music. Yes. The form of rakha in play with alapi is more prominent. This gets less laya. This is very gentle. Later, we increase the form of lay to the higher level All the So our gathering has reached the end of the session So what will you teach us according to the laya? I will teach you a dhrita bandish It is in Madhavanti Raag It is in three taal So I will play it now Aapu! Aapu! Yes, it's about your dad. Who was the father? I don't know. My brother went to school and got back home. It's not what it seems. You know it's from your dad, right? Yes. It's from your brother. So, the real reason has been.. ..not because he's good or anything.
